analysis.title: US Morning Call: November 20, 2026
key_insights: Goldman's US morning call covers the consumer during retailer earnings season: Buy WMT, Neutral TGT after 3Q earnings (Kate McShane), and Buy TJX, ROST and GAP (Brooke Roach).
Walmart (Buy): share gains continued across categories, supported by price investment. FY26 guidance was raised.
Target (Neutral): 3Q comp strength was led by traffic, while apparel remains under pressure. CapEx is expected to increase in FY27.
TJX (Buy): F3Q27 earnings review says the Marmaxx recovery is gaining traction, with freight and fuel pressures in focus.
Ross Stores (Buy): F3Q26 earnings review says strong share gains continue.
Gap (Buy): F3Q26 earnings review says Old Navy shows sequential progress. A softer start to holiday led to a reduced FY26 outlook.

Utilities (Carly Davenport): Buy the IPP sell-off, with Buy on TLN, VST and NRG. Estimates were updated for select IPPs following earnings and elections, and the desk prefers PJM over ERCOT in the near term.
